notice: Pinned architecture and source reviews; independently implemented ideas, not a claim of full upstream validation or copied code.

projects.name: dna-engine
projects.adopted: Coverage and file-quality evidence remain separate from biological interpretation.
projects.integration: Independent VCF evidence audit; no marker catalog or ancestry reference copied.

projects.name: DNAgent
projects.adopted: One operation engine serves desktop and agents; exports carry explicit context and coordinate conventions.
projects.integration: Shared typed workflows, six-frame exploration and an explicit local agent handoff.

projects.name: bi0cyph3r
projects.adopted: Separate reversible educational encoding from encryption and biological interpretation.
projects.integration: Independent UTF-8 DNA message studio; no upstream cryptography or plasmid code bundled.

projects.name: gin-schnaps
projects.adopted: Keep selection, biological coordinates and export provenance distinct.
projects.integration: Independent interval receipts and strand-aware motif exploration. GPL source is not incorporated.

projects.name: SpliceCraft
projects.adopted: Flush and verify state before replacement; separate persistent libraries from transient UI state.
projects.integration: Independent durable JSON writer for job state and backed-up appearance settings.

projects.name: DNALONGBENCH
projects.adopted: Choose the prediction task and validate input shape before installing or evaluating a model.
projects.integration: Five-task input readiness checks only; no models, training runs or datasets downloaded.

projects.name: mdna
projects.license: MIT root; bundled submodules retain separate licenses
projects.adopted: Sequence geometry, molecular simulation and printable educational models have different purposes.
projects.integration: Scientific structure reference; our printable helix remains a schematic, not atomic simulation.

projects.name: sovereign-dna
projects.adopted: Present evidence beside research actions and require explicit approval for external AI data sharing.
projects.integration: Grouped sequence-lab navigation, source-linked reports and a local-only agent evidence export.

projects.name: dna
projects.adopted: Linked document and network views can support traceable evidence exploration.
projects.integration: Architecture reference only: this is discourse analysis, not genetics. Its included JAR has restrictive terms and is not bundled or installed.
